summary.en: The claim a print carries, set in code on label stock on a glass above it: a pencil tick, a short label over a large value, a shadow on the print.
summary.zh: 一张截图所承载的主张，用代码排在它上方玻璃层的标签纸上：一道铅笔竖线，短标签在上，大数值在下，投影落在截图上。

fits: One number or name a print proves, kept readable over the print.
notFor: Several claims on one print; long sentences.

intent.en: The one thing to remember from a print, restated in code where it cannot be misread.
intent.zh: 从一张截图里要记住的那一件事，用代码重新写出来，不会读错。

content.en: A label (≤ 26 chars / 12 字) and a value (≤ 11 chars / 6 字) printed in the asset (or `~` when read off an axis).
content.zh: 标签（≤ 26 字符 / 12 字）和素材里印着的数值（≤ 11 字符 / 6 字；从坐标轴读出的写 `~`）。

fits.zh: 一张截图证明的那个数字或名字，在截图上方保持可读。

notFor.zh: 一张截图上多条主张；长句。

en: Step it aside when a measure would lie under it.
zh: 有测量要画在它下面时先把它移开。

fits: any launch argued from published evidence

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
